g1_1_business.what_it_does: Lenskart Solutions Limited is a direct-to-consumer omnichannel eyewear company that specializes in prescription eyewear, sunglasses, and contact lenses. The company leverages technology to provide AI-enabled vision testing and has a vertically integrated manufacturing process, allowing it to control costs and quality. Lenskart operates both online and offline, with a significant number of retail stores across India and international markets.

customers.description: Individuals seeking eyewear solutions, including first-time buyers and repeat customers.

manufacturing.description: Central manufacturing facilities for eyewear production, including automated lens edging.

competitive_advantage: Proprietary technology for site selection and remote optometry.
Vertical integration leading to lower costs and higher margins.
Strong brand loyalty with high Net Promoter Score (NPS).
Rapid expansion in both domestic and international markets.
Significant market share growth potential in a fragmented industry.

drivers.title: Store Expansion
drivers.fact: Lenskart added 603 net new stores in FY26.
drivers.why_it_matters: This expansion allows for increased market penetration and revenue growth.
drivers.evidence_quote: Driven by 603 net new stores added in FY26 compounding at 20%+ SSSG and scaling international margins.

drivers.title: Smart Eyewear Launch
drivers.fact: B Smart Glasses soft launched in Q4 FY26 with 30,000+ waitlist.
drivers.why_it_matters: This product diversification can attract new customers and increase sales.
drivers.evidence_quote: B Smart Glasses soft launched in Q4 FY26 with 30,000+ waitlist.

drivers.title: Increasing Market Penetration
drivers.fact: Lenskart targets to increase its market share from ~5% to 15-20% over 5-7 years.
drivers.why_it_matters: Achieving this target would significantly boost revenue and brand presence.
